body.statement: For every \(c\in\mathcal C_K\), the primal program defining \(V_c\) is feasible for every \(\xi\in\mathbb R^{S_c}\), and \[V_c(\xi)=\max\{\ell^\top\xi:|\ell^\top b_t|\le\theta_t^2\text{ for every }t\in\mathcal T_c\}.\] The dual feasible set is compact on \(\mathbf 1^\perp\), \(V_c\) is finite, convex, even, continuous, and positively homogeneous, and \(0<\kappa(c)\le1\). For rational \(c\), primal and dual optimizers and \(\kappa(c)\) are exactly rational and terminate under finite linear programming.
body.justification: The gauge is the finite-alphabet object that converts multi-arm response geometry into a scalar Airy coefficient.
body.gap: Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2026), Theorem 3.1, has no response-alphabet linear program because its reduced experiment is scalar.
body.consumer: The exact primal-dual record supplies both the shrinkage score and the rational input to the finite certificate.
